text: ζητεῖ τὸν ἄρτον, ἀλλ᾽ οὐκ ἔστιν ὁ ἄρτος ἐν τῇ οἰκίᾳ.
objects: a low round wooden table with a smooth oak surface and sturdy legs at child height
a small brown cloth sack with a simple drawstring and soft wrinkles
several small round silver coins with Greek letters stamped on both sides
artist_notes: Hold the composition from the previous frame for continuity; let Dinosaur’s head motion suggest searching.
positioning: Dinosaur is still left foreground, now leaning slightly back from the table in three-quarter view, eyes scanning the room and then back to the table, puzzled.
The low round wooden table remains center midground, unchanged in angle and placement.
The small brown cloth sack remains on the right edge of the table, drawstring loose.
The several small round silver coins remain clustered at the center of the table, untouched.
